name: Word learning app
install:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.8.22/install.sh | sh
fi
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" /usr/local/bin/uv
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/uvx" /usr/local/bin/uvx
uv sync --all-groups --frozen --inexact
flet_version="$(uv run python -c 'import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version("flet"))')"
uv pip install "flet-web==${flet_version}" "flet-mcp==${flet_version}"
start:
set -euo pipefail
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/; then
  echo "Flet web server already listening on port 8000"
  exit 0
fi
env -u DISPLAY FLET_FORCE_WEB_SERVER=true PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 uv run flet run --web --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 . > /tmp/flet-dev.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/flet-dev.pid
for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
  if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/; then
    echo "Flet web server ready on port 8000"
    wait "$(cat /tmp/flet-dev.pid)"
    exit $?
  fi
  if ! kill -0 "$(cat /tmp/flet-dev.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Flet web server exited before it was ready" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "Flet web server did not become ready on port 8000" >&2
exit 1
